checkpointKind: pilot / mid-work adversarial review, one badge derived end to end

oneBadgeEndToEnd.subject: the Public works nav badge
oneBadgeEndToEnd.chosenBecause: it is the claim R3 routed rather than fixed, it is the lens with TWO regions so the rollup is exercised, and it appears in all three renderings the paired control now covers

chain.fact: CIP_PROJECTS_DOMAIN and CALL_ANALYTICS_DOMAIN both declare lensId public-works
chain.consequence: public-works is in REGISTERED_LENS_IDS, so it is not the fifth state, so Not built is not available to it. src/fixture-seam.mjs: absent from the registry means the surface does not exist, which is the only surviving meaning of Not built.

chain.fact: on template-city, powerbi and goto are both in fixtureGrants and both generators return records, so both regions resolve status ok with recordCount 16 and 25
chain.verifiedAt: GET /api/city-domains?cityKey=template-city, raw output in this artifact

chain.fact: web/app.js loadPublicWorksLens fetches /api/domains/cip-projects and /api/domains/call-analytics for the active cityKey; a non-ok response becomes unreadRegion, a positive did-not-read determination with its own basis, never an empty city
the two region statuses resolve by LENS_BADGE_ORDER (the seam's DOMAIN_STATUSES plus did-not-read) to ok, and LENS_BADGE.ok is the word Demo records
one label writes three elements: #pw-state-chip, .navitem[data-lens=public-works] .badge, and [data-lens-row=public-works] .pill. They cannot diverge because there is one write.
#pw-region-rule prints 2 of 2 regions sourced with the rule inline, beside the chip, so the single word is never the whole claim
before any of the above resolves the document says Not read in all three places. It states that nothing has been read; it makes no claim about the surface or the pack.
the static partition is recomputed from DOMAIN_REGISTRY on every run, so the day a domain is added to or removed from public-works and the markup is not touched, the gate goes red naming the lens

ungranted.renderedProof: Police lens on template-city, patrol-vehicles region: kicker 'No source', head 'No source is granted for the Patrol roster region on template-city.', basis 'Spireon is not granted on template-city; the Patrol roster region is built and has no source'

granted-empty.how: composeDomain on a probe pack granting mygov, with a generator returning zero records
granted-empty.statedPlainly: no shipped pack reaches granted-empty: template-city grants six kinds and every granted generator returns records, and empty-city grants nothing. The state is constructed in src/lens-claims.test.mjs exactly so the word is not unreachable code. It becomes reachable the day a real adapter returns zero, which is the day it matters.

did-not-read.how: a failed fetch, produced in the browser by aborting the domain route
did-not-read.note: a fifth DETERMINATION rather than a fourth state: a read that failed is not an empty city

fourSourceStatesDrivingTheBadge.distinctness: five determinations, five words, asserted equal in count to their set size so a future edit cannot collapse two

adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.checked: did the fix move the lie rather than remove it
adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.finding: no. Walked on template-city AND empty-city, dark AND light, six lenses each, plus a failed-read arm. Every one of the 24 pack/theme/lens cells reads a word the seam produced for that pack. empty-city renders Empty, which is what it rendered before this lane, so the honest-empty pack is unchanged.

adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.checked: is the Police rollup a new flattening
adversarialReviewOfTheWorkSoFar.finding: it is a rollup and it is declared. Police on template-city has one ok region and one ungranted region and the badge says Demo records. The ungranted region says so in full on the lens, in three separate strings, and the page header prints '1 of 2 regions sourced' beside the chip. A test pins the mixed case, so a future change that makes both regions read the same fails.

findingRoutedNotFixed.what: the accessibility gate fails LOCALLY on unmodified main
findingRoutedNotFixed.measurement: npm run test:a11y on a worktree at 3452b31 (origin/main, no changes) produces the identical failure string as on this branch: color-contrast 44 unresolved nodes per theme, sample #nav-demonstrated and #nav-sources-rule, reason elmPartiallyObscuring
findingRoutedNotFixed.soWhat: this branch adds zero a11y failures - the two runs are byte-identical in their failure message - and the same commit's a11y job on GitHub Actions concluded success (run 32326231384). Local and CI disagree on a required gate. Two numbers that should agree and do not is a free finding (DEV_PROCESS 1.4), and it is routed rather than chased here: CI is authoritative for merge, and the PR's own a11y conclusion string is what this lane reports.
